description: Switch the launch page to live mode and request publication after automatic checks. First use launchpad_get, show the person the saved launch note and primary link (the first button: its label and where it goes, a link or Your page), and wait for a clear yes. Requires confirm: true after that approval and a claimed handle with an enabled safe HTTPS primary link or primary_target page. A pending_review or review_pending hold is not live: explain owner_reason, do not retry or bypass review. If launchpad_get shows offline: true, the page stays offline until launchpad_set_offline with offline: false. Sends no campaign. Requires API key scope: draft.

confirm.description: true only after the person saw the launch note and primary link and approved going live.

name: launchpad_go_live
title: Launchpad go live
